headline: Warehouse Associate | General Laborer | Material Handler
summary: Reliable operations worker with experience supporting warehouse, shipping, receiving, loading, unloading, inventory movement, facilities support, and route delivery tasks in fast-paced environments.

experience.title: Warehouse / General Labor / Delivery Support
bullets: Supported fast-paced operations by moving materials, staging inventory, organizing work areas, and completing assigned tasks safely and on schedule.
Loaded, unloaded, sorted, packed, and prepared materials for shipment or delivery.
Followed supervisor instructions, safety procedures, and quality standards in warehouse and field environments.
Maintained clean work areas and reported equipment, inventory, or safety issues when identified.

experience.title: Production / Facilities / Maintenance Helper
bullets: Worked independently and with teams to complete physically demanding tasks in changing work conditions.
Supported preventive maintenance and general facilities tasks using hand and power tools under site-specific procedures.
Helped teams stay on schedule by adapting quickly to shifting daily priorities and operational needs.
